depends_on.name: input_id
depends_on.documentation: The statement leaf(s) this value was COMPUTED from (its inputs). A statement with inputs in the dataset is a calculation; this edge is what makes it one. Typed to a statement leaf -- never an entity.

fields.name: redundant
fields.documentation: True = this calculation adds NO information beyond its inputs: an exact, deterministic, choice-free rebuild exists (per-gene totals summed from the counts), so it is safe to delete. Most calculations are NOT redundant -- a clustering, a label transfer or a fit depends on method, version and randomness. Nothing may cite a redundant document as a provenance input (item 31; T6).
